title: Natural assembly of compatible ordinary system isomorphisms
statement: Fix independent site and coefficient universes t and u. For a site J on C:Type(t+1) with morphisms in Type t and an EssentiallySmall witness in max(u,t+1), with a strict tower B of commutative ring sheaves and quotient transitions τ [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], let F and G be functors from any category D to the ordinary system category. Suppose for every level n a natural isomorphism δ_n:F⋙evaluation(n)≅G⋙evaluation(n) is given, and its components commute with every transition n≤m. There exists a natural isomorphism ξ:F≅G such that evaluation(n)(ξ_P)=(δ_n)_P for every P and n. Only ordinary module systems occur; no derived equality is detected by evaluation.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0941, strict coefficient systems and compatible maps.

proof.text: At each input object, apply the proved objectwise systemIsoOfEvaluation_exists to the finite isomorphisms and their transition squares.

For each input arrow, evaluate the two naturality composites. The normalization of the assembled isomorphisms reduces their equality to naturality of δ_n. Evaluations are jointly faithful because they read every section of the sequence site. NatIso.ofComponents gives the natural isomorphism, with the same evaluation normalization.

theorem naturalIsoOfEvaluation_exists
    {D : Type*} [Category D]
    {C : Type (t + 1)} [Category.{t} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [EssentiallySmall.{max u (t + 1)} C]
    (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}) (τ : ∀ n, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)
    (F G : D ⥤ SemilinearSections.Systems.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)} J B τ)
    (δ : ∀ n, F ⋙ SemilinearSections.evaluation J B τ n ≅
      G ⋙ SemilinearSections.evaluation J B τ n)
    (ht : ∀ P {m n} (h : n ≤ m),
      (SemilinearSections.transition J B τ h).app (F.obj P) ≫
        (SemilinearSections.res (SemilinearSections.coefficientMap J B τ h)).map
          ((δ n).hom.app P) =
      (δ m).hom.app P ≫ (SemilinearSections.transition J B τ h).app (G.obj P)) :
    ∃ ξ : F ≅ G, ∀ P n,
      (SemilinearSections.evaluation J B τ n).map (ξ.hom.app P) =
        (δ n).hom.app P
